2026-10-23-59.title: The connection line is easy to read
2026-10-23-59.body: Lines such as “Live updates paused” went under the top bar. Now they show at the bottom of the screen, where other messages show, and the top bar stays in its place.

2026-10-23-56.title: Join a task as a helper
2026-10-23-56.body: Do you work on a task that another person leads? Open the task and press “Join as a helper”. Your name then shows on the task, and its lead gets a notice. To leave, press “Leave this task”.

2026-10-23-57.title: The lead can delete a task
2026-10-23-57.body: Did a task go into the wrong project? Its lead can now delete it: open the task and press “Delete task” at the end. The person who added the task gets a notice. Undo brings the task back.

2026-10-23-58.title: Past-due words fit on a phone
2026-10-23-58.body: On a phone, a long line such as “Past due by 157 days” went under the chat button of a task. Now the line goes on to a second line.
